items.excerpt: Astronomers combined VLA and MeerKAT radio observations of Hycean world K2-18b with an automated machine-learning pipeline trained to separate human interference from genuine narrowband signals across millions of candidates. No technosignature was found, but the ML approach makes future SETI searches far faster.

National University of Singapore scientists trained a machine-learning model on 2,391 scent molecules from 991 aromatic plants, reaching 96.1% accuracy in identifying sleep-promoting compounds. The work shows AI mining plant chemistry to surface candidate bioactive fragrances for research.

Tohoku University researchers built ChatHEA, a domain-specific large language model that ran the full discovery workflow, from literature mining and element-combination design to experimental planning and mechanistic analysis, to identify high-entropy alloy catalysts for fuel cells. The AI-guided high-throughput loop surfaced strong oxygen-reduction catalysts beyond human intuition.

Computer scientist Peter Denning argues that mainstream AI has inherited a flawed assumption from Turing's 1950 paper, contending that machines cannot encode the tacit, embodied knowledge, like common sense and practical skill, that underlies human cognition. The critique reframes how cognitive science should evaluate claims of human-level machine understanding.
